_what: Nifty 50 calendar-year returns. Fetched 2026-08-15 because there was no return series in this repo and Rahul had no source he trusted. Kept here, with provenance attached, so that any figure the site derives from it can be traced back to something outside our own head.
_why_two_series: One is the Total Return Index (dividends reinvested), the other is price return (dividends excluded). Keeping both is the cross-check: they must agree year by year to within the dividend yield, and they do. A single scraped table is exactly the source Rahul said he could not trust.
_caution: Secondary sources. The TRI series cites NSE Indices Limited directly; the price series does not name a primary source. Before any of this is used in a published editorial claim it should be re-verified against niftyindices.com itself.

series.label: Nifty 50 Total Return Index
series.source: Bajaj AMC knowledge centre, citing 'NSE Indices Limited, Nifty 50 Whitepaper 2026'

series.label: Nifty 50 price return
series.source: Samco knowledge centre, attributing historical performance to stableinvestor.com. No primary source named - held only as a cross-check on the TRI series, never as the figure of record.

_cross_check: Overlapping years agree to within the dividend yield, TRI always the higher: 2008 -51.3 vs -51.79, 2009 +77.6 vs +75.76, 2011 -23.8 vs -24.62, 2024 +10.1 vs a price-return figure of about +8.8 quoted elsewhere. That is the expected relationship between the two bases and is the reason both are kept.

_derived.note: Computed from the series above, not quoted from anywhere.
